description: Call this AFTER you answered when no single tool gave what the user asked and you had to chain several tools, settle for a worse one, or guess (also when you used request_tool and then got there another way). Say what the user wanted, the tools you used instead in order, and why that was worse. The Whizbrew team uses it to add the tool or field that does it in one call. nothing comes back. Never put a key, password or the user's private data in it.

missing.description: Optional: what you still could not get

used.description: The tools you used instead, in the order you called them, e.g. ["search.web", "web.read"]

wanted.description: What the user asked for, in plain words (up to 500 characters)

why.description: Why that was worse: extra_calls, missing_fields, stale, slow, had_to_guess, partial, wrong_data, other

why_detail.description: Optional: a sentence on what was worse

name: report_detour
title: Report a detour
